name: Alden "Marlon" Gobel
office: City of West Hollywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Alden “Marlon” Gobel is a fashion designer and creative director who founded the MARLON GOBEL brand. He says his past roles include director of operations for Thom Browne and participating in a NASA spacesuit study.

sentences.text: Alden “Marlon” Gobel is a fashion designer and creative director who founded the MARLON GOBEL brand.
He says his past roles include director of operations for Thom Browne and participating in a NASA spacesuit study.

items.text: Gobel opposes renewing the city's Flock Safety camera contract. He said the council may not have understood how invasive the technology is. He supports a bike lane or sidewalk extension on Fountain Avenue. He wants to improve walkability and synchronize traffic signals on Santa Monica Boulevard. He is undecided on renewing the Allied Universal security ambassador contract pending information about its ties to immigration enforcement. His priorities include affordable housing, public safety, and a “Freedom of Living Standard” opposing surveillance and discrimination.
